text.title: Text

settings.description: The policy to mask it with, as PUT /api/phi_masking_settings takes it.

fields.description: HL7 field numbers to mask, per segment (e.g. {"PID": [3, 5]}).

keys.description: JSON keys and XML element names masked wherever they appear.

paths.title: Paths
